name: Fleet Management
description: At-a-glance view of Bitcoin miners on the local network

fleet_name.name: Fleet name
fleet_name.description: Heading shown above the fleet overview

bos_password.name: BOS password
bos_password.description: Root password used to log into every BOS miner on the network

ubos_username.name: uBOS username
ubos_username.description: User name used for HTTP Basic auth against every uBOS device on the network

ubos_password.name: uBOS password
ubos_password.description: Password used for HTTP Basic auth against every uBOS device on the network

model_whitelist.name: Shown models
model_whitelist.description: JSON array of model-name fragments to show; empty shows all (e.g. ["bmm101"])

model_blacklist.name: Hidden models
model_blacklist.description: JSON array of model-name fragments to hide

bos_enabled.name: Show BOS miners
bos_enabled.description: Include BOS miners in the fleet view and keep polling them

ubos_enabled.name: Show uBOS miners
ubos_enabled.description: Include uBOS devices in the fleet view and keep polling them

axeos_enabled.name: Show AxeOS miners
axeos_enabled.description: Include AxeOS miners in the fleet view and keep polling them
